remediations.finding: GitHub Actions warned that older action releases used deprecated Node.js 20
remediations.change: Pinned checkout 7.0.1, setup-python 7.0.0, setup-node 7.0.0 and upload-artifact 7.0.1 to their immutable Node.js 24 commits

remediations.finding: Historical silent-video and internal approval wording was too prominent in judge-facing documentation
remediations.change: Current narrated video is the sole judge path; the older Unlisted recording is reduced to a factual audit note and internal approval wording is absent from current submission copy

remediations.finding: The optional hosted playback script still targeted the earlier Unlisted recording and its pull-request trigger would produce a known YouTube bot-gate failure unrelated to application correctness
remediations.change: Point the script at the current narrated video and retain it as an explicit manual evidence workflow rather than a branch or pull-request gate
remediations.result: No bot check is bypassed and no blocked observation can be represented as PASS

remediations.finding: Pull-request workflow runs were associated with the PR head but checkout used GitHub's synthetic merge commit by default
remediations.change: Every protected CI job now checks out github.event.pull_request.head.sha explicitly, falls back to github.sha on main pushes, and disables persisted checkout credentials
remediations.result: Final artifact source_commit must equal the reviewed PR head; strict branch protection separately requires the branch to be up to date
